title: LSASS memory access with full-access rights by hidden PowerShell on SCRANTON (and via WinRM on NASHUA)
rationale: All describe the same action: PowerShell.exe PID 2976 (pbeesly, spawned by control.exe stager) opened lsass.exe with 0x1F3FFF/0x1FFFFF and read process memory on scranton, with UNKNOWN call-trace frames; F19 is the same LSASS-access pattern via wsmprovhost.exe on nashua during the pbeesly remote session. Best fit is LSASS Memory (T1003.001).

title: SAM server full-access handle requests on SCRANTON
rationale: 4656 events show SAM_SERVER handles with 0xf003f requested by lsass.exe; consistent with Security Account Manager access, though brokered by lsass and not confirmed as dumping. Best fit T1003.002.

title: Screen-capture loop writing BMPs to Downloads on SCRANTON
rationale: Invoke-ScreenCapture loop capturing the desktop to BMP files is GUI input capture; best in-scope fit is GUI Input Capture (T1056.002).

title: Forced-authentication artifacts: Folder handler hijack and StartUp hostui.lnk on SCRANTON
rationale: Same action: PowerShell planted HKCU Folder\shell\open\command hijack and StartUp hostui.lnk, and later launched hostui.exe. Forced Authentication (T1187) fits the handler-hijack/forced-auth mechanism.

title: accesschk.exe writing passwordsDB in SysinternalsSuite on SCRANTON
rationale: File named passwordsDB created by accesschk.exe in the malicious session; content unobserved, so unconfirmed credential store. Best fit Unsecured Credentials (T1552).

title: Credential-bearing file harvesting, archiving, and plaintext-password lateral use (SCRANTON to NASHUA)
rationale: Same action chain: enumeration of credential-named files and Compress-Archive/Rar staging on scranton and nashua, plus use of the plaintext domain password Fl0nk3rt0n!T0by with PsExec64. Credentials In Files (T1552.001) fits the observed credential collection from files.

title: Get-PrivateKeys export of LocalMachine certificate private keys to .pfx on SCRANTON
rationale: Both describe the same Get-PrivateKeys script block exporting cert:\LocalMachine certificates to password-protected .pfx files in Downloads and subsequent cleanup. Best fit is Steal or Forge Authentication Certificates (T1649).

title: Root certificate store Blob modification on NASHUA by Sysmon.exe
rationale: Single 4657 event modifying a ROOT certificate Blob; no corroborating theft. Best fit Steal or Forge Authentication Certificates (T1649).

title: Credential-access tooling staging and anti-forensic cleanup on SCRANTON and NASHUA
rationale: Fake .scr staging, folder enumeration, and sdelete64 wiping of tooling/archives is defense evasion/indicator removal, not credential access; best ATT&CK fit is T1070.
